## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] API inputs remain validated and database-specific behavior stays behind dialect or adapter boundaries.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, connection strings, private schema data or generated local files.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated documentation when setup, configuration, API contracts or architecture changed.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, tests, builds and `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` pass for the affected packages.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior remains disabled by default or requires an explicit opt-in.

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visible frontend changes, when applicable.
